text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Defeat... Once again...?
Scattered, fallen, scattered once more...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...I see. I, too, have finally come to understand
the will of the ancestors of the House of Rose.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Once, every member of our house reached for glory. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
A victory out of reach no matter how desperately yearned for.
Mounting impatience, fading hope.
And amidst it all...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
They must have exhausted their strength,
entrusting their hopes to future generations.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Perhaps I, too, am standing at such a crossroads right now...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Should I gracefully devote myself to the garden?
No, and yet—
choice_data_list: Through the canopy... the sunlight is still coming in...
Voicing weakness is not like you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
In the first place, I only stand here today
thanks to the devotion of my ancestors. To take that—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I cannot allow it all to come to naught.
The one who must shoulder this weight right now is me—
Rose Kingdom.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Very well—let us begin. I shall show them that a supple rose vine never breaks.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—!
You speak with unusual... intensity.
However—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
That must be how grave an error...
I am on the verge of committing.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, there is no reason you would admonish me so sternly.
Indeed, I had grown far too fainthearted.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
choice_data_list: No, as long as you understand.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I have burdened you with a painful role...
If that is so—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I shall surely reward your tireless efforts.
In the next race.
